mapper.select: WITH RANKED AS ( SELECT P.STOCK_ID ,P.TRADE_DATE ,P.CLOSE_PRICE ,P.VOLUME ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY P.STOCK_ID ORDER BY P.TRADE_DATE DESC) AS RN FROM T_STOCK_PRICE P ) SELECT S.ID AS STOCK_ID ,S.SYMBOL ,S.NAME ,S.MARKET ,L.TRADE_DATE ,L.CLOSE_PRICE ,L.VOLUME ,B.CLOSE_PRICE AS PREV_CLOSE ,L.CLOSE_PRICE - B.CLOSE_PRICE AS CHANGE_AMOUNT ,ROUND((L.CLOSE_PRICE - B.CLOSE_PRICE) / B.CLOSE_PRICE * 100, 2) AS CHANGE_RATE ,S.SHARES_OUTSTANDING ,L.CLOSE_PRICE * S.SHARES_OUTSTANDING AS MARKET_CAP FROM T_STOCK S JOIN RANKED L ON L.STOCK_ID = S.ID AND L.RN = 1 LEFT JOIN RANKED B ON B.STOCK_ID = S.ID AND B.RN = 2 WHERE 1=1 AND S.USE_YN = 'Y' AND S.DEL_DAY IS NULL ORDER BY S.ID

SELECT R.STOCK_ID ,R.TRADE_DATE ,R.CLOSE_PRICE ,R.VOLUME FROM ( SELECT P.STOCK_ID ,P.TRADE_DATE ,P.CLOSE_PRICE ,P.VOLUME ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY P.STOCK_ID ORDER BY P.TRADE_DATE DESC) AS RN FROM T_STOCK_PRICE P ) R WHERE 1=1 AND R.RN <= #{days} ORDER BY R.STOCK_ID ,R.TRADE_DATE

SELECT S.ID AS STOCK_ID ,S.SYMBOL ,S.NAME ,S.MARKET ,D.TITLE AS DOC_TITLE ,D.CONTENT AS DOC_CONTENT FROM T_STOCK S LEFT JOIN T_STOCK_DOC D ON D.STOCK_ID = S.ID AND D.DEL_DAY IS NULL WHERE 1=1 AND S.SYMBOL = #{symbol} AND S.DEL_DAY IS NULL ORDER BY D.ID LIMIT 1
SELECT P.TRADE_DATE ,P.OPEN_PRICE ,P.HIGH_PRICE ,P.LOW_PRICE ,P.CLOSE_PRICE ,P.VOLUME FROM T_STOCK_PRICE P JOIN T_STOCK S ON S.ID = P.STOCK_ID WHERE 1=1 AND S.SYMBOL = #{symbol} ORDER BY P.TRADE_DATE
